title: Manage-sell-offer with offer ID -1 must be refused
caps_note: offerID has been an int64 since the first protocol; the rule is in the XDR definitions and stellar-core's ManageOffer validation, not in a CAP.
why: ManageSellOfferOp.offerID is an int64 that stellar-core requires to be non-negative; a builder that accepts a value outside that range encodes another offer ID, so the operation edits or deletes a different offer, or is refused as malformed.

known_divergences.detail: Executed on 17.2.0 and 17.2.1: Operation.manageSellOffer accepts -1 and encodes it, which stellar-core rejects as malformed; 17.3.0 refuses the value (fix pull request #1780).
known_divergences.evidence: probe vector 2o4 (evidence/sdk-matrix), executed on js 17.2.0 and js 17.2.1; xcc conform run --columns 'js@*' --entries 'classic/api-offer-id-encoding.id-negative'

known_divergences.detail: Executed on 16.3.0, 16.3.1 and 16.4.1: Operation.manageSellOffer accepts -1 and encodes it, which stellar-core rejects as malformed. The 17.3.0 fix is not on the 16.x line.
known_divergences.evidence: probe vector 2o4 (evidence/sdk-matrix), executed on js 16.3.0 and js 16.3.1 and js 16.4.1; xcc conform run --columns 'js@*' --entries 'classic/api-offer-id-encoding.id-negative'

known_divergences.detail: Executed on 17.0.0 and 17.0.1: ManageSellOffer accepts the offer ID -1 and encodes it as ffffffffffffffff, which stellar-core rejects as malformed. The default branch refuses it (a ValueError for an offer ID outside 0 to 2^63-1); no release after 17.0.1 carries the fix yet.

notes: Built by xdrcheck-corpus synth from corpus/recipes/classic/api-offer-id-encoding.id-negative.json. Origin: probe vector 2o4, in evidence/sdk-matrix/vectors/vectors.json, executed in every probe column (evidence/sdk-matrix). stellar-core returns MANAGE_SELL_OFFER_MALFORMED for a negative offer ID (ManageOfferOpFrameBase.cpp, v30.0.0), so a builder must not produce one. Expected values were computed from the XDR definitions, the CAP or SEP text and the stellar-core rule cited under related, with an independent encoder; no SDK output was used.
